customManagers.description: Action refs in scaffolded workflow templates are pinned to a full commit SHA with a trailing `# vX` comment, so a fresh scaffold passes its own Semgrep mutable-action-tag gate (#629). The github-actions manager cannot parse the .tmpl files ({{#if}} blocks break YAML), so match uses: lines directly to keep the digest and its version comment fresh. The optional subpath group captures owner/repo as depName for subdirectory actions like github/codeql-action/upload-sarif (#576).
